crossRefs.note: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.

translations.web: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.
translations.bsb: The cow will graze with the bear, their young will lie down together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox.
translations.kjv: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
translations.asv: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together; and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
